svg.title: HLA immunoprecipitation and peptide elution
svg.desc: Native ligand LC–MS/MS and DNA-encoded engineered peptide–HLA screening are different assays. Neither peptide detection nor presentation alone proves functional alloreactivity. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.

g.inkscape:label: HLA class I / HLA-E peptide complex

Enlarged free peptide, no binding orientation implied
